oracle: Known native two-layer fixture. Actual pointer-down public view is captured before any movement; it must equal the pre-gesture export at the same declared phase. With original binary foreground alpha and opaque Green guide, opaque foreground RGB is read directly from that view and clear foreground cells stayRGBA0. This independently observed immutable starting frame supplies the live-source pixels, never a call to the Smudge kernel. Writes stay within max12,Size radius plus1px of the declared horizontal path; outside RGBA and every guide/non-target field remain exact. In x<154, only Red and clear can contribute to a rightward drag because Blue startsx160. Every nonzero-alpha pixel there must retain pure RedRGB within1/255, even as alpha changes: premultiplied resampling cannot introduce black or sample the Green guide. The source-clear gap develops partial alpha with at least3 levels (feathering). Its alpha-weighted Red-region centroid moves right, and full Strength shifts farther than15% at each matching size/layout/source kind. Each complete source Undo/Redo and actual fresh input is exact; live definitions restore exactly on Undo, and fixed10000ms frames are compared explicitly. Independent Pillow composition over the known Green guide agrees within1/255. Empty-space paths at y20 and Size22 cannot touch Red/Blue paint starting at y60. They must preserve the entire document, including real live definitions and animation, and must not add a hidden Undo step over the primed rename. For live rows, controlled phase10371 is observed while held before movement and, for clear-only, after release: genuine Water must still vary before any paint is actually moved. No screenshot-only or metadata-only substitute is used.
live_scope: Real moving Water fill over Blue, verified at three phases. Pressing/holding or moving wholly in clear space must not freeze it or change its definitions/history. Only a meaningful Smudge edit may bake active-layer live ink to a raster; that representation change is recorded, its initial fixed-phase image must remain equivalent, and Undo restores the exact original definitions. Other layers remain exact. Only live render/performance reads are fixed for reproducibility; actual RAF scheduling, Date/timers and trusted events remain. No age, holding-duration or performance claim uses the fixed value.
